response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including C++ (though primarily early in his career), and demonstrates strong technical depth in areas like concurrent programming and architecture. However, his recent work has been heavily focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and web/mobile development, with limited evidence of recent C++ or industrial automation experience. His background lacks direct exposure to IEC 62443, message brokers, or cloud platforms like Azure, which are critical for this role. The mismatch between his expertise and the job requirements reduces his overall fit.
strengths: Strong background in C++ (early career at National Instruments), demonstrating foundational knowledge in the language
Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby, real-time apps in Dlang)
Experience with secure development practices (TDD, CI/CD, and code quality standards) and mentorship (e.g., organizing workshops)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was in 2015), with a shift toward JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js
No visible experience with industrial automation protocols (e.g., Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA) or IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards
Lacks cloud platform experience (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and message-broker-based architectures, which are key for the role
